description: This file defines the CentralEnd class, which models the end of central directory record in a ZIP file, including methods for reading from and writing to ZIP input/output streams.

classes.name: CentralEnd
classes.description: Represents the end of central directory record in a ZIP file, with methods to read from and write to ZIP streams.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a CentralEnd record from a ZipInput stream, returning null if signature does not match.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Retrieves the logger instance for CentralEnd class.

methods.name: doRead
methods.description: Performs the actual reading of the CentralEnd fields from the ZipInput stream.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes the CentralEnd data to a ZipOutput stream.
